narrative.overview: The Smart Glasses Detector web presence (docs/index.html and docs/privacy.html) replaces dark-glow software cliches with a bright, unhurried hardware inspection sheet (#f5f6f3 mineral paper over crisp #ffffff plates and #eceee8 calibrated workspace bays). Every claim is anchored to verifiable on-device facts—0 B network transmission, Android 12+ neverForLocation operation, interactive -90 to -30 dBm Gate proximity simulation (-55 dBm trigger), and actual Android screenshots displayed as numbered archival plates.
keyCharacteristics: High-legibility daylight mineral ground (#f5f6f3) paired with carbon ink (#14191e) and strict 1px perimeter hairlines (#d4d8cf).
Clean typographic separation between Korean/English reading prose (Noto Sans KR) and tabular telemetry, hex signatures, and Android permission constants (JetBrains Mono).
Flat elevation hierarchy using surface tonal shifts (#ffffff / #f5f6f3 / #eceee8) and hairline compartments instead of drop shadows or blur glass.

rules.name: The Flat Ledger Rule
rules.body: Boundaries, status bays, and data matrices are always drawn with crisp 1px structural borders and muted mineral surface shifts rather than soft shadows, blur halos, or multi-pixel left stripe accents.

rules.name: The Signal Semantic Rule
rules.body: Never apply emerald, amber, or red purely for decorative branding; reserve those hues strictly for RF proximity tiers (GUARD, AMBER, GATE RED), privacy verification highlights, and high-visibility limit callouts.

rules.name: The Script Integrity Rule
rules.body: Never set Korean headings, table headers, or buttons in monospace fallback fonts; keep every Hangul phrase in Noto Sans KR and restrict JetBrains Mono strictly to identifiers, hex literals, and English telemetry labels.

dos: Do keep word-break: keep-all on Korean headings and body text so multi-syllable words never split awkwardly mid-line.
Do place figure codes (FIG. 01–04) strictly below headings as plate sub-labels rather than floating kickers above headlines.
Do align simulated threshold markers and percentage track boundaries directly to exact dBm values (58.33% for -55 dBm inside -90..-30 dBm).
donts: Don't place mini uppercase kickers or eyebrows directly above <h1>, <h2>, or <h3> headings.
Don't use drop shadows, glassmorphism blur, neon-on-dark gradients, or 2px–4px left accent border stripes (border-left) on callouts or navigation items.
Don't organize features or screenshots into padded 2x2 equal cards with leftover blank vertical voids inside each cell.
